name: math4wisdom-superhuman-docs-archive
description: A fail-closed, local archive tool for the Math4Wisdom Superhuman Docs document.

scripts.discover: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js discover
scripts.dry-run: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js dry-run
scripts.archive: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js archive
scripts.validate: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js validate
